name: EuRoC stereo-inertial SOTA bakeoff v1
goal: README figures/tables claiming visloc-rs beats Basalt, ORB-SLAM3 (stereo-inertial), and VINS-Mono / VINS-Fusion on the same protocol.
sensor_mode: stereo camera + IMU (VINS-Mono reported on a separate mono-inertial row)

methods.notes: Single frozen motion-VI config after Basalt-parity gate passes.
Re-run locally; paper/table numbers only as external_published fallback.
Stereo-Inertial mode; same EuRoC yaml calib.
Mono-inertial; never merge into stereo-inertial win claims.

scoring.alignment: SE3 (rigid) primary; Sim3 scale reported as diagnostic only
scoring.coverage: tracked_fraction over full sequence length; deaths count as failures in the denominator
scoring.aggregation: Per-sequence mean over reps, then mean/median/worst across 11 sequences

basalt_parity_mh01.notes: Must pass on full MH_01 (not 800f truncated) before bakeoff README rows.

published_reference_ballpark_m.notes: Literature ballpark only; bakeoff cells must prefer local re-runs.

blocker: visloc tracking cliff (~0.56 coverage / 800f) must close before any README win claim.
